entities.summary: Saints Joachim and Anne in Tuscolano is a church in Rome. The church is dedicated to Saints Joachim and Anne, parents of the Virgin Mary. Santi Gioacchino e Anna al Tuscolano is a church building in Europe, established in 1982. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
